imagery_provider: NASA GIBS WMS / MODIS Terra true color

tests.name: Death Valley / Lake Manly basin
tests.evidence: USGS documents paleolake history and satellite mapping of active channels/alluvial fans.

tests.name: Bonneville Salt Flats / Lake Bonneville remnant basin
tests.evidence: Dry-basin analogue. This test limits interpretation to visible geomorphology until DEM/geology validation is added.

tests.name: Ebro valley / Aragón semi-arid river corridor
tests.evidence: ESA describes an arid setting with irrigation and a major active river; this is a retention analogue, not a paleoriver claim.

tests.name: Po River low-water corridor
tests.evidence: ESA documented exceptional low water in 2022; useful for exposed-bar and channel-contraction comparison.

tests.name: Tanezrouft Basin ancient water-erosion terrain
tests.evidence: ESA explicitly notes evidence of water erosion from a wetter Sahara.

tests.name: Tsauchab River / Sossusvlei
tests.evidence: ESA identifies the Tsauchab as an ephemeral river ending in Sossusvlei; historically flow reached farther west.

tests.name: Lop Nur / Tarim terminal basin
tests.evidence: Dry terminal-basin morphology is used to inspect old inflow patterns; specific paleochannels require SAR/DEM confirmation.

tests.name: Aral Sea / Amu Darya–Syr Darya terminal basin
tests.evidence: ESA documents long-term shrinkage after river diversion; used as a storage-and-routing cautionary analogue.
